messages:
Lina Gomez: quick FYI 1: we ran the partner throughput/efficiency sweep with NebulaBoard today. raw artifacts uploaded to S3 (link below). looking for engineering + GTM alignment on kernel flag handoff and a soft market claim we can include in co-listing. @Oliver @Nina?
benchbot: artifacts: s3://redwood-partners/nebulaboard/2026-03-23/sweep-114.tar.gz :file_folder: 
benchbot: headline: sustained throughput 3.9k req/min, avg p95 34ms, perf/W 5.2 tokens/s/W (quant=int8). full CSV attached.
Oliver Park: thx. curious whether perf/W measured per-node or end-to-end (including host power).
benchbot: perf/W = model tokens/sec divided by board DC power draw measured at 30s steady window (host excluded).
Nina Patel: ok that's fine, but marketing will want 'system perf/W' for marketplace if we include in co-marketing. we should be explicit in the one-pager.
Lina Gomez: agreed. engineering: can we get a quick delta if partner applies our mmap prefetch + civlib flag? we saw ~8% perf/W uplift in internal silicon tests.
Evan Brooks: I ran a micropatch last week. on our lab rig I saw perf/W go from 5.2 -> 5.6 tokens/s/W and p95 improve ~2ms. patch uses ENABLE_KV_PREFETCH + page-align hint. small diff below.
Evan Brooks: ```
--- a/runtime/civlib/config.h
+++ b/runtime/civlib/config.h
+// enable kv prefetch for partner runtimes
+#define ENABLE_KV_PREFETCH 1
+// align large pages to 2M to reduce TLB churn
+#define PREFETCH_PAGE_ALIGN 2MB
```
Evan Brooks: partner build will need symbol ENABLE_KV_PREFETCH and the runtime to call prefetch_align before mmap.
Oliver Park: note: some partner firmwares default to squash small mmap requests, so the patch may not apply cleanly. we should provide a fallback plan.
Nina Patel: fallback = list a "typical" perf/W number and link to full bench report. also add a line: "results based on Redwood test harness; partner results may vary." Legal prefers that language.
Lina Gomez: draft marketplace text suggestion: "Typical throughput and efficiency observed on NebulaBoard with Redwood-optimized runtime. See full test report for configuration and testing methodology." keeps it conservative.
Evan Brooks: operational note: if partner can't enable prefetch, we'll recommend running one tier up (instance size +1) in the routing policy to maintain p95 SLA. add to runbook.
Oliver Park: can we capture specific prompts where int8 quality regressed? Nina, marketing wants a note about quality checks.
Nina Patel: I'll carve out a 200-prompt regression set from our eval buckets and run both int8 and int8+fp16 hybrid. will share results in 48h.
benchbot: queued ab jobs: 9001=int8, 9002=int8-fp16-hybrid, ETA 2h 30m.
Lina Gomez: timeline proposal:
- Day 0: share patch + integration notes with Nebula (this thread).
- Day 1-2: Nebula applies patch, runs partner CI (we provide docker+scripts).
- Day 3: Redwood does validation + quality regression.
- Day 4: sign-off, handoff marketplace assets (one-pager, bench CSV, sample config).
Nina Patel: I'll draft copy and sample config (include exact build flags and test seed) by EOD PT.
Oliver Park: engineering will need Nebula's CI logs and kernel build output. ask partner to upload to sftp.
Lina Gomez: action items: Lina -> share integration gist + scripts; Evan -> attach micropatch and perf logs; Nina -> regression prompts + marketplace draft; Oliver -> prepare routing fallback note. Nebula PM was cc'd off-thread and will ack separately.
Nina Patel: tagging legal to review the conservative marketplace phrasing once draft is up. :eyes: 
Lina Gomez: thanks team. will regroup after benchbot completes the AB sweep. :thumbsup:
